source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板 (src/world/megaton.js) の改修用。画像が無いあいだは既存の素材に色を付けて代用している。自分で作った 3x3 の画像を assets/textures/sheets/<id>.webp に置くか、texgen.py generate で生成する
style: Front views of home furniture and appliances for a space-habitat apartment. Each cell is ONE object seen exactly straight on, filling the cell edge to edge, flat even light, no background, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-fridge
cells.prompt: A white two-door refrigerator front, freezer on the bottom, slim vertical handles, a few magnets and a child drawing.

cells.name: mg-washer
cells.prompt: A white front-loading drum washing machine front: round glass door, control panel with a small display at the top.

cells.name: mg-tv
cells.prompt: A flat TV screen showing a bright daytime scene of a garden under a blue sky, thin black bezel.

cells.name: mg-wardrobe
cells.prompt: A light wooden wardrobe front with two tall doors and simple metal handles.

cells.name: mg-kitchen
cells.prompt: The lower cabinets of a white fitted kitchen seen front-on: doors and drawers with slim handles, a plinth at the bottom.

cells.name: mg-shoebox
cells.prompt: A low wooden shoe cabinet front at an apartment entrance, slatted doors, a small vase on top cut off at the edge.

cells.name: mg-aircon
cells.prompt: A white wall-mounted air conditioner indoor unit front, wide flap, small indicator light.

cells.name: mg-bookshelf
cells.prompt: A home bookshelf front: shelves with books, a plant, framed photos and small toys.

cells.name: mg-washbasin
cells.prompt: A bathroom washbasin unit front with a large mirror above, cabinet doors below and a soap bottle.
